hook.say: True or false? Five facts about the Americas, three seconds each. Number five twists your mental map!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Ecuador is named after the Equator.
questions.fact: Ecuador is simply the Spanish word for equator.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Ecuador is simply the Spanish word for equator.

questions.q: The Amazon rainforest lies entirely in Brazil.
questions.fact: Only about 60% is in Brazil. Peru, Colombia and others share the rest.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Only about 60 percent is in Brazil. 8 other countries share the rest.

questions.q: Brazil is named after a tree.
questions.fact: The name comes from brazilwood, a tree prized for its red dye.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The name comes from brazilwood, a tree once prized for its red dye.

questions.q: Aconcagua, the highest peak outside Asia, is in Chile.
questions.fact: It stands in Argentina, close to the Chilean border.
questions.sayAnswer: False! It stands in Argentina, close to the border with Chile.

questions.q: The Panama Canal's Atlantic end is west of its Pacific end.
questions.fact: The canal runs northwest to southeast across a bend in the isthmus.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Panama bends like an S, so ships heading to the Pacific actually sail southeast.
